pickBoth: Pick a table on each side.
sortHint: Sort by this column (Shift+click adds another)
changedHere: Only rows where this column is different
filteredCount: Showing {{shown}} of the {{total}} that pass the filter.
allFiltered: With a filter set, it marks only the rows that pass it.
matchFiltered: Remove the filters to make everything match at once.
partial: Partial comparison: up to {{limit}} rows were read from each side, ordered by the key, and the table has more. The different rows are confirmed on both sides. Rows that appear on only one side may exist on the other past what was read, so they are not inserted or deleted.
partialUnordered: Partial comparison: up to {{limit}} rows were read from each side, without being able to order them by the key, and the table has more: each side may have read different rows. The different rows are confirmed on both sides. Rows that appear on only one side may exist on the other, so they are not inserted or deleted.
partialRow: In a partial comparison this row is not inserted or deleted: it may exist on the other side.
duplicates_one: 1 row with a repeated key was compared once.
duplicates_many: {{count}} rows with a repeated key were compared once.
duplicates_other: {{count}} rows with a repeated key were compared once.
onlyLeftColumns: Columns only the left has (not compared): {{list}}
onlyRightColumns: Columns only the right has (not compared): {{list}}
showingFirst: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}}; the “All” buttons also mark the ones you can't see.
hint: Pick the table on each side and hit Compare. Rows are matched by their primary key, even on another connection or another engine.
scriptSummary: {{parts}}, in the target's language. Review it before running it.
matchHint: Marks the different rows and the ones missing on that side. The ones that would have to be deleted are chosen separately, in their own view.

update.left: The left gets the values from the right
update.right: The right gets the values from the left

insert.left: Insert this row on the left
insert.right: Insert this row on the right

delete.left: Delete this row from the left
delete.right: Delete this row from the right

bothSides: Both sides change: when you run it, the left script runs first and then the right one. If one fails, the other doesn't run.

mismatch.title: Not the same table
mismatch.name: Careful: you're not comparing the same table ({{left}} against {{right}}). Syncing would change the data of another table.
mismatch.schema: Careful: it's a different table with the same name in another schema ({{left}} against {{right}}). Syncing would change the data of another table.

ai.keyHint: Proposes the columns that identify each row: a unique index of columns that don't take NULL or, if there's none, what the AI says from the columns' names and types.
ai.keyUnique: Key suggested by a unique index: {{list}}.
ai.keyAi: Key suggested by the AI: {{list}}. Check that it doesn't repeat.
ai.keyNone: There's no key to suggest: choose the columns that identify each row.
ai.keyNoneNoAi: The table has no unique index to use as a key. With an AI provider set up, the AI can also be asked.
ai.askPlaceholder: Filter with AI: for example, the ones that differ only in price, the most expensive first
ai.askHint: The AI turns the request into the grid's filters and order. {{provider}} gets the columns' names and types and the request, never rows.
ai.filterNothing: The AI found no way to filter that with the comparison's columns.
ai.explainHint: The AI explains what the differences have in common and their likely cause. {{provider}} gets counts and typical gaps per column, never the rows' values.
ai.explained: Explanation by {{provider}}, from counts and typical gaps
